$comment: D-CORE-COMPOSITE-OVERLAP-CLAIM-BLIND-TO-UNIONS: `compositeFieldsOverlap` now answers `true` for a union carrying neither explicit offsets nor bit-fields (every member sits at byte 0, so they share bytes by definition; it used to answer `false`). BOTH callers consult that authority before deciding whether a positional member-wise write is meaningful, so the truthful answer would have made both REFUSE `union U u = {1};` — a construct gcc, clang and MSVC all accept. Both now route unions past the gate, because a union initializer names exactly ONE member (C 6.7.9p17): one write at offset 0, no sibling to lose. ★ TWO TIERS, DIFFERENT CODE: blocks (1)-(3) declare LOCALS and exercise the MIR brace-init lowering (`hir_to_mir.cpp` `lowerAggregateInitIntoSlot`, runtime stores); blocks (4)-(5) read FILE-SCOPE objects whose bytes the STATIC-DATA encoder produced at COMPILE time (`asm.cpp` `encodeAggregateValue`), which carries its own separate copy of both the gate and the route — no local declaration reaches it. ★ NO TARGET ARMS: a union needs no shipped descriptor to be spelled, which is exactly what makes this reachable where `overlap_struct_zero_init`'s explicit-offset overlay was pe/macho-only, so every target runs the SAME program and the same exit code. ⚠ EVERY CHECK IS ENDIAN-AGNOSTIC: block (3) and (4) prove the overlay is live by asking whether writing one member changed the other, never by masking `b`'s low bytes — `a` occupies b's LOW bytes little-endian and its HIGH bytes big-endian, so a mask would be a target test wearing a portability claim. THE SCORE IS A CHECKSUM, NOT A TALLY: 8+8+9+8+8 = 41, so dropping or short-circuiting any ONE block changes the exit code even when every check that ran passed. RED-ON-DISABLE, separately observable per tier: delete the union route in `lowerAggregateInitIntoSlot` and blocks (1)-(3) fail with error[H_UnsupportedLoweringForKind] `brace-initialization of an overlapping explicit-offset struct`; delete it in `encodeAggregateValue` and blocks (4)-(5) fail with error[K_NoMatchingObjectFormat] `static initialization of an overlapping explicit-offset struct`. Release arm re-runs the whole program through the shipped optimizer (the single-member stores are DCE/CSE bait — they must survive as real stores).
